ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This online course that begins January 26th and ends May 4th includes four face-to-face class sessions at the College of Medicine in Peoria. The site-based classes are scheduled to be held in room A-200-2 on January 26th, February 23rd, Mar 30th and May 4th (Monday evenings) from 6:00 to 9:00 PM. Students will also meet online using the Elluminate conferencing system on four other Monday evenings. The online sessions will occur on February 9th, March 9th, April 6th and April 20th from 6:00 to 8:00 PM. The email address for the instructor is dcrowell@illinois.edu
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $372.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
